AI customer service on WhatsApp

No customer left unanswered. And the proof, in numbers.

Anyone can have a bot that answers. Atalaia takes care of what comes after: if the person who picked up the conversation goes quiet, the AI talks to the customer again, the dashboard alerts that person and the manager, and you see everything in numbers.

For companies that sell over WhatsApp and have a team handling the conversations.

How it works

The AI answers, the team takes over, and no one is left without a reply

On one side, your customer's WhatsApp. On the other, your team's dashboard. Both at the same instant.

  1. 14:02. Marcos, from Serra Preta Peças, asks about KT‑4410 on WhatsApp. The AI replies within seconds that it carries KT‑4410 and asks for his CNPJ and email; the quote card builds itself with Part KT‑4410 and Quantity 2.
  2. 14:05. Marcos sends his CNPJ and email. The AI notes them, hands the conversation to sales with everything ready, and it lands in the Queue as Waiting for an agent.
  3. 14:06. Bruno Sales takes over the conversation, which leaves the Queue and becomes In progress with him. He writes: Hi, Marcos! This is Bruno, I'll send you the quote right away.
  4. 14:20. Marcos asks: Bruno, can you still send it to me today? Nobody replies. The clock runs until 14:35 and the "waiting 15 min" alert heats up. The 15 minutes count within business hours; outside them, the AI steps in right away.
  5. 14:35. The AI steps back in without taking the conversation away from Bruno. The dashboard shows: The AI has been replying to the customer since 14:35, because Bruno didn't respond. Marcos receives: Hi, Marcos! I've noted that you need it today. Someone from our sales team will confirm and reply as soon as possible. The dashboard alerts Bruno and then the manager, Helena Prado.
  6. 15:35. One business hour without Bruno: the conversation goes back to the Queue tagged “Bruno dropped it”, and Camila Duarte takes over and replies. The “AI stepped in” counter goes from 13 to 14.

In short

Three steps, and no customer gets left behind

The AI handles what it can, your team handles what needs a person, and Atalaia watches the path between the two.

1. The AI answers from your catalog

It recognizes codes, brands and product lines, reads photos, PDFs and audio, and resolves what it can. A quote request comes out with part, quantity, city, email and CNPJ.

KT‑4410seal kit · KT line
"3/4 inch hose"MH‑34‑R1 or MH‑34‑R2?

2. Whatever needs a person goes to your team

On the same number, with no need for the customer to message another contact. The conversation lands in the queue with a summary, and anyone can take over with one click. The quote comes from your team, at the price your company set.

partquantitycityemailCNPJ

3. If whoever took over goes quiet, the AI speaks up again

During business hours, after 15 minutes without a reply, the AI talks to the customer again without taking the conversation away from whoever took over. After hours, it steps in right away. The dashboard alerts whoever picked it up and then the manager, and after one business hour without a reply the conversation goes back to the queue with the name of whoever dropped it.

When your customer reaches out, and when your team replies

Each little square is one hour of the week. The brighter it is, the more messages. In gold, what arrived after hours. Hover or tap: both maps light up the same hour.

Everything in gold, outside the frame, is a customer reaching out while your team is at home. On the team's map that area stays dark: that is where the AI keeps things running.

The week on a single page

The weekly report wraps up the week for people who don't want to open charts: conversations, after-hours contacts, first-response time, who handled what. Only the manager opens it.

Yours, in a spreadsheet

Export to CSV, by agent or by conversation. The data belongs to your company and leaves the dashboard whenever you want.

Dashboard rebuilt with fictional data, assembled with the dashboard's outcome rules: "resolved by the AI" is a conversation where the AI replied, nobody needed to take over, and the customer stayed 48 h without coming back. That is why the rate looks lower over 7 days: the newest conversations are still open. "No reply from the AI" is a real failure, and the dashboard shows it instead of hiding it. "Open now" is today's state and does not change with the period.

What it will never do

Trust is built by also saying what stays out.

  • Never

    makes up prices, delivery times or stock. It only uses what your company defined: without your system connected, the quote comes from your team.

  • Never

    pretends to be a person. If asked, it says plainly that it's the assistant and brings in someone from the team right away.

  • Never

    forces a "type 1, 2 or 3" menu. A real conversation, one question at a time.

  • Never

    lets a conversation disappear. If nobody takes over, the dashboard alerts the team again and then management. If whoever took over goes quiet, it steps in for the customer.

Frequently asked questions

Before you ask

I already use Meta's bot. Do I need this?

Meta's bot replies and hands off to a person. What happens after that is on us: who took it over, how long the customer waited and what to do when nobody replies.

How is this different from the big customer service platforms?

On those, you usually pay per agent, set the time limits and build the reports yourself. Here it all comes ready, the team is unlimited and we build the AI from your catalog.

Is the WhatsApp number mine?

Yes. It stays in your Meta Business account, and Meta bills WhatsApp fees directly to you. Atalaia adds nothing on top.

How is a conversation counted?

Each customer who talks to you counts once per day. If they come back the next day, it counts again.

What if I go over my tier?

Each extra conversation costs R$ 3. On Starter, you never pay more than Growth. On Growth, if you go over 2,500 conversations in a month, we'll talk to you about Scale before charging for the overage.

Does the AI give prices to customers?

You decide. Without your management system connected, it doesn't quote prices: the quote comes from your team. With the system connected, as a separately quoted service, it checks your price table and can build the quote. Either way, it never makes up a price, delivery time or stock level.

Can I change what the AI says after it goes live?

Yes, and it's included in your subscription. Promotions, campaigns, new products and fixes: you ask, and we update the AI within 2 business days.

Is there a long-term commitment?

On the monthly plan, no. The annual plan is 15% off with a 12-month contract.

Why "Atalaia"

The one who keeps watch so that no one is left waiting.

In ancient cities, the atalaia, the lookout, was the first to see who was arriving. That is what we do for your customer service: someone watching over every conversation, from the first hello until your team replies, so that none of your customers goes unanswered.
